Kibble.Election.LeaderElector module¶

Leader election via MongoDB heartbeats.

Every monitoring node writes a heartbeat document to the monitors collection. The node with the lowest monitor_id is elected leader. Leadership is evaluated every heartbeat cycle, and the next-lowest ID takes over automatically.
